completion_data.completion_summary: A fifth, semantic-only object language L^▷ (L⁺ plus the open-future and open-past modals) is landed in FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/ with all 31 planned theorems proved sorry-free: the Ockhamist principle is valid for the open-future operator over every task frame, its stability transposition is refuted on a three-state integer-time frame satisfying every FrameOver field, the open-past mirror follows by frame reversal, and S5 plus the strict strength ordering box => stability => open-future are machine-checked. Four headline theorems are axiom-pinned and the documentation sweep, including the root README, is committed.

notes: Vacuous grep over all of FormalSystem/ matches one pre-existing 2025 line (int_domain_universal := trivial in Examples/TemporalStructures.lean), a genuine proof outside this task; count recorded for task files.
